scope: server-owned source admission boundary and undeployed FDC candidate review

admission_boundary.policy_binding: SHA-256 of complete canonical finite policy JSON; not a digital signature or permission proof
admission_boundary.unknown_or_deletion_required_sources: excluded; no physical purge capability is claimed
admission_boundary.withdrawal_semantics: future access revocation; historical rows, SQLite pages/WAL and backups may remain
admission_boundary.fdc_json_in_tavily_registry: rejected; dedicated fixed-ID API flow required
admission_boundary.review_changes: aliases, rights, identity, adapters and nutrient choices change the digest and require review

fdc_candidate.identity_scope: raw Fuji with skin only; explicit fuji_with_skin variant; no generic apple, peeled/cooked or branded substitution
fdc_candidate.preparation_enum_convention: mixed + raw denotes unheated whole-food compatibility in the existing enum; not a cooking claim
fdc_candidate.reuse_scope: server_internal; owner-bound; no cross-user cache approval
fdc_candidate.retention: selected nutrient evidence, normalized profiles/portions/hashes and existing durable snapshots; not hash-only

validation.sqlite_acceptance: temporary DB policy save, close/reopen, digest equality, withdrawal blocks current lookup, retained withdrawn policy explicit, zero nutrition profiles
negative_cases: publisher approval separate from provider approval
unknown deletion requirement and purge-on-withdrawal obligation
cross-user scope without separate provider approval
single-request or no-provider-storage scope entering durable pipeline
invalid review shape, reviewer, timestamps and evidence URLs
FDC relabelled as Tavily or placed in the Web registry

execution_notes: Initial unittest import failed because PYTHONPATH did not include backend; corrected before the successful run
First full pytest run was interrupted and not counted; restarted with explicit skip-local-env, empty DATABASE_PATH and cleared provider/external-database variables
Existing API tests already set skip-local-env and empty DATABASE_PATH during collection; no production operation was part of this work
review_limits: Technical self-review based on previously captured official evidence; not a new publisher permission or legal opinion
Admission validator and Web builder do not replace food identity, nutrient cell, profile provenance, authority or route checks
The low-level SQLite policy repository remains a server-owned primitive; the FDC review is not installed there in production
Candidate variety/skin must match server-owned identity; no new identity correction or normalization rule was added
No new live Detail retrieval, full real-source photo pipeline, accept/meal-save browser/mobile acceptance or production activation
remaining_gates: Tavily actual plan/application scope and each original publisher permission/adapter; unqualified sources stay excluded
Isolated real-source preview/accept/save acceptance within existing workflow; no repeat of completed phone fixture
Final registry/flag/deployment review before any activation
